description: Synthetic evaluation set. Resumes/job descriptions were written by the project author; labels were assigned by the same author following the rubric in docs/evaluation.md BEFORE running the system. Single annotator, small sample.

labels.Matched: skill named in the resume (or implied by a more specific named tool)
labels.Partial: related skill/tool named or related activity described without naming the skill

cases.note: Typical data-science resume; ML only implied by tool usage.
cases.resume:
Skills
Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, Matplotlib
Experience
Built a churn prediction model using sklearn and evaluated it with cross-validation.
Cleaned and merged customer tables with pandas and SQL queries.
Presented results to the marketing team.
cases.jd:
Requirements
- Python
- SQL
- Machine learning
- Data visualization
- Communication skills
Nice to have
- Docker
